what: diagnose_cpr(): what is wrong with the column
title: Getting started with pnr
text: Ask first CPR column produce : Every value gets one status: valid, missing, scientific notation, wrong length, characters, invalid date. notes problems overlap errors, tells data : restored leading zero means Excel, scientific notation means digits gone source must read column text. report shows counts row numbers, never CPR numbers, can go log. rows behind check kept result: modulus-11 failure note: since 2007 CPR office issues numbers satisfy .
code: x <- c("0101004007", "010100-4007", "101004007", "1.01004E+08",        "3102004007", "12345", "ukendt", NA, "1111111118") diagnose_cpr(x, as_of = "2025-01-01") #> ── CPR diagnosis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ! 4 of 9 valid (2 distinct) #> ✖ 1 missing (row 8) #> ✖ 1 in scientific or decimal notation: digits are lost, read the source again as text (row 4) #> ✖ 1 with the wrong number of digits (row 6) #> ✖ 1 with characters other than digits, dashes and spaces (row 7) #> ✖ 1 with ten digits but no real birth date (row 5) #> ℹ 1 had lost a leading zero (Excel), restored by cleaning (row 3) #> ℹ 1 contained dashes or spaces (row 2) #> ℹ 3 valid, sharing their CPR number with another row (rows 1, 2, 3) #> Birth dates 1911-11-11 to 2000-01-01; 75.0% male. d <- diagnose_cpr(x, as_of = "2025-01-01") d$checks[, c("check", "kind", "n")] #>               check    kind n #> 1             valid problem 4 #> 2           missing problem 1 #> 3        scientific problem 1 #> 4      wrong_length problem 1 #> 5         non_digit problem 1 #> 6      invalid_date problem 1 #> 7     zero_restored    note 1 #> 8        separators    note 1 #> 9       mod11_fails    note 0 #> 10         repeated    note 3 #> 11 born_after_as_of    note 0 #> 12   older_than_120    note 0 d$checks$rows[d$checks$check == "invalid_date"][[1]] #> [1] 5

what: add_cpr_info(): birth date, age, sex, and validity
title: Getting started with pnr
text: add_cpr_info() appends selected information preserving original CPR column. Dashes, spaces, lost leading zeroes handled internally, native rules clean_cpr(). CPR parsed requested outputs, including multiple age calculations. Use clean_cpr() explicitly identifier also used joins export: Without selections, function adds bday, age, sex, mod11, valid. Bare age age() use today’s date; explicit references make analysis reproducible. Write output_name = calculation rename result. age calculation reference, several ages can added one call: age(year) defaults "primo" primo = "previous_ultimo" (31 December previous year); "medio" means 1 July "ultimo" means 31 December. year can scalar, column, expression evaluated original input data. default makes opening ages equal previous year’s closing ages. can also written explicitly: Someone born 1 January 2000 0 counting year 2001; age(year, primo = "jan1") instead includes day’s birthday gives 1. specific date, use age(date = ...) Date ISO date string. Supply one reference rows one per row. Missing references give missing ages. Use .env$name explicitly access caller variable column name. Existing output names cause error guidance rename selection use .overwrite = TRUE. Duplicate output names always error, source CPR column overwritten. valid means ten digits encoding real calendar date, confirmation CPR number assigned. Missing invalid CPR values give valid = FALSE. mod11 independent checksum part valid. Choose mod11 explicitly selecting outputs need . Age counts completed calendar years, elapsed days divided 365.25. person born 29 February, age increases 29 February leap years 1 March non-leap years. birth date 29 February 2000: age(2024) means age 31 December 2023 default, giving age 23 example. Add byear birth year integer; among defaults.
code: df |>   dplyr::mutate(pnr = clean_cpr(pnr)) |>   add_cpr_info(pnr, age(year), sex, bday) df <- data.frame(   pnr = c("1111111118", "111111-1118", "111111118"),   year = c(2024L, 2025L, 2026L) ) add_cpr_info(df, pnr) #>           pnr year       bday age sex mod11 valid #> 1  1111111118 2024 1911-11-11 114   0  TRUE  TRUE #> 2 111111-1118 2025 1911-11-11 114   0  TRUE  TRUE #> 3   111111118 2026 1911-11-01 115   0 FALSE  TRUE add_cpr_info(df, pnr, sex, birth_date = bday) #>           pnr year sex birth_date #> 1  1111111118 2024   0 1911-11-11 #> 2 111111-1118 2025   0 1911-11-11 #> 3   111111118 2026   0 1911-11-01 df |>   add_cpr_info(     pnr,     primoalder = age(year),     medioalder = age(year, "medio"),     ultimoalder = age(year, "ultimo"),     sex,     bday   ) #>           pnr year primoalder medioalder ultimoalder sex       bday #> 1  1111111118 2024        112        112         113   0 1911-11-11 #> 2 111111-1118 2025        113        113         114   0 1911-11-11 #> 3   111111118 2026        114        114         115   0 1911-11-01 add_cpr_info(df, pnr, primoalder = age(year, primo = "previous_ultimo")) #>           pnr year primoalder #> 1  1111111118 2024        112 #> 2 111111-1118 2025        113 #> 3   111111118 2026        114 add_cpr_info(df, pnr, alder = age(date = "2025-07-01")) #>           pnr year alder #> 1  1111111118 2024   113 #> 2 111111-1118 2025   113 #> 3   111111118 2026   113 df$reference <- as.Date(paste0(df$year, "-01-01")) add_cpr_info(df, pnr, alder = age(date = reference)) #>           pnr year  reference alder #> 1  1111111118 2024 2024-01-01   112 #> 2 111111-1118 2025 2025-01-01   113 #> 3   111111118 2026 2026-01-01   114

"1111111118.0" similar decimal forms counted . wrong_length: digits, nine ten . non_digit: contains characters digits, dashes spaces. invalid_date: ten digits, first six real date. notes overlap problems . errors, says something data : zero_restored: nine digits, padded leading zero. Since 2007 CPR office issues numbers satisfy , error (https://cpr.dk). large share among older birth dates can still point typing errors. repeated: valid values occur . Expected panel one row per person year, problem table persons. born_after_as_of older_than_120: valid numbers whose decoded birth date implausible data. usually typing errors happen form real date, wrong as_of. diagnosis never prints CPR number, counts row numbers, output can go log. row numbers every check kept returned object.
